855	prevailing over the revealed.	prevalecendo sobre o revelado.
856	There was a certain Jewish rabbi, a rabbi in the United States,	Havia um certo rabino judeu nos Estados Unidos,
857	who was one of the few who in those times had permission to enter	que era um dos poucos que, naquela época, tinham permissão para entrar
